对于这些人的积极性，爻雪非常地满意，她看了一眼剩下的异能觉醒药剂，说道：“我会为你们提供一个空间背包，让你们带着异能觉醒药剂和食物一起出发。”

闻言，司凡刚想要感谢，就听到爻雪话音一转，接着说道：“先别急着感谢，这些不是免费给你们的，都是需要扣除积分的，以后慢慢还就行。”

听到爻雪这样说，司凡到嘴边的感谢的话瞬间收了回去。

等到这些人离开天台之后，爻雪也跟着回到了一楼，刚一来到一楼，就看到李磊慌慌张张地朝着自己这边走来。

“店长，出事了，有人外出被怪物抓伤了，您快去看看吧。”

听到李磊这样说，爻雪看向人群聚集的地方，此时那里正躺着鲜血淋漓的两个人，其中一人胸口有着三道深深的抓痕，痕迹深可见骨，看上去十分的恐怖，另外一个的伤势则是更严重，他的伤口在腹部，整个腹腔被撕开了一个口子，鲜血和内脏都流了出来。

此时这两人已经是出气多进气少了，眼看就只能等死了。

看到爻雪出来，原本围拢的众人下意识地给她让出了一条通道。

李磊跟在爻雪的身后，看着地上两人凄惨的模样，不由得捂住嘴巴，眼泪在眼眶里面打转。

爻雪看着地上的两个人，看着他们的脸，并没有认出两人的身份，想来应该并不是自己经手的客人之一，或者都还没有办理入住。

见着两人还有一口气在，她对着李磊说道：“你去找苏辰，就说这里有两名受伤生命垂危的人需要救治。”

闻言，李磊不知道店长为什么要让自己去找苏队长，那些人看上去可不像是医生，但介于对爻雪的信任，他还是转身朝着苏辰等人所居住的房间走去。

就在李磊去找人的时候，人群中有一名身材中等的中年男人举手说道：“店长，我是医生，可以帮着急救。”

Yaoxue was very satisfied with the enthusiasm of these people. She glanced at the remaining power awakening potions and said, "I will provide you with a space backpack so that you can set out with the power awakening potions and food."

Hearing this, Si Fan was just about to thank him when he heard Yao Xue's voice change, and then said: "Don't thank me in a hurry. These are not given to you for free. Points need to be deducted. You can pay them back slowly in the future."

Hearing Yaoxue say this, Si Fan immediately took back the words of thanks that came to his lips.

After these people left the rooftop, Yaoxue followed them back to the first floor. As soon as they arrived on the first floor, they saw Li Lei walking towards him in a panic.

"Store manager, something happened. Someone was scratched by a monster when he went out. Please go and have a look."

Hearing what Li Lei said, Yaoxue looked at the place where the crowd gathered. At this time, two people were lying there dripping with blood. One of them had three deep scratches on his chest. The marks were deep enough to see the bones. It looked very scary. The other one's injury was more serious. His wound was in the abdomen. The entire abdominal cavity was torn open, and blood and internal organs flowed out.

At this time, the two of them were breathing more out than in, and they could only wait to die.

Seeing Yaoxue coming out, the people who had gathered around subconsciously made way for her.

Li Lei followed Yao Xue and looked at the miserable appearance of the two people on the ground. He couldn't help but cover his mouth, tears welling up in his eyes.

Yaoxue looked at the two people on the ground, looked at their faces, and did not recognize their identities. It seemed that they were not one of the guests she dealt with, or they had not checked in yet.

Seeing that the two of them were still breathing, she said to Li Lei: "Go to Su Chen and tell him that there are two injured and life-threatening people here who need treatment."

Hearing this, Li Lei didn't know why the store manager asked him to find Captain Su. Those people didn't look like doctors, but because of his trust in Yao Xue, he turned around and walked towards the room where Su Chen and others lived.

Just when Li Lei was looking for someone, a middle-aged man of medium build in the crowd raised his hand and said, "Store manager, I am a doctor. I can help with first aid."
